title: Register with Minnesota Secure Choice or certify a retirement plan exemption
authority: Minnesota Secure Choice Retirement Program Board
description: Private employers with five or more employees and no qualified plan must enroll in the program or file an exemption, on a staggered schedule: 100 or more employees by June 30, 2026, down to 5 to 9 employees by June 30, 2028. Minnesota law authorizes civil penalties and requires a written warning during the first year of noncompliance; the board's final dollar schedule is not stated in its current employer guidance.

appliesWhen.description: 5 or more employees in the state

exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.
